title: Move benchmark-like (timing-threshold) tests out of the test suite into a separate benchmark run that keeps its results
outcome: The maintained test suite checks behaviour only: no test passes or fails on wall-clock duration or throughput. Costly performance measurements run separately as benchmarks whose results are kept for comparison over time. Starts only after the current sync work lands.
acceptance: An inventory lists every test in the TermAl Rust, Node and Vitest suites that asserts on elapsed time, throughput or a timing deadline as its subject (not a bounded wait for an event), with file, test name and what it measures.

Each listed test is either converted to a deterministic behavioural assertion (for example, a count of operations or lock-held work) or moved to a separate benchmark entry point outside the full gate, with the reason recorded per test.
The benchmark entry point records its results durably (machine, commit, metric values) so runs can be compared over time, and docs/test.md describes how to run it and where results are kept.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
